# Driveway Mechanic Astro site code review (2026-02-27 04:27Z)

_**User**_

Do a thorough code review of the Driveway Mechanic Astro site at /Users/felixtorres/.openclaw/workspace/projects/driveway-mechanic/site. The site builds clean and serves on port 4327.

Check ALL of the following and report back with a detailed list of issues found (with file paths and line numbers):

1. **Broken or dead links** — Check every `<a href="...">` across all pages/layouts/components. Verify each destination exists as a generated route. The build output shows these routes exist:
   - /404.html, /affiliate-disclosure/, /buy/, /buy/best-obd2-scanners-2026/, /disclaimer/, /fix/, /fix/car-wont-start-clicks/, /fix/check-engine-light-on/, /learn/, /maintain/, /maintain/how-to-change-oil-toyota-camry/, /privacy-policy/, /seasonal/, /index.html, /rss.xml
   
   Flag any href that doesn't match one of these routes OR is a valid external URL (https://).

2. **Consistency issues** — Check that the same data/labels aren't hardcoded differently in different places. For example, the site name, tagline, copyright year, URL, etc.

3. **Unused imports/variables** — Scan .astro and .ts files for imports that aren't used.

4. **HTML validity** — Check for unclosed tags, duplicate IDs, missing alt text on images, invalid attribute combinations.

5. **SEO issues** — Check meta tags, canonical URLs, JSON-LD validity, og tags on each page template.

6. **TypeScript issues** — Look for `any` types, missing type annotations where they'd help, type mismatches.

7. **Mobile responsiveness** — Check for hardcoded widths, missing responsive classes, text overflow issues in Tailwind classes.

8. **Performance** — Unused CSS, blocking scripts in head, large inline data.

Read the key files: src/layouts/Layout.astro, src/layouts/Article.astro, src/pages/index.astro, src/pages/fix/index.astro, src/pages/fix/[...slug].astro, src/pages/maintain/index.astro, src/pages/maintain/[...slug].astro, src/pages/buy/index.astro, src/pages/buy/[...slug].astro, src/pages/learn/index.astro, src/pages/seasonal/index.astro, src/pages/404.astro, src/pages/privacy-policy.astro, src/pages/rss.xml.ts, src/lib/hubs.ts, content.config.ts, astro.config.mjs, tailwind.config.cjs

Return a prioritized list of issues: CRITICAL (would break the site), HIGH (visible to users/SEO), MEDIUM (code quality), LOW (nice to have).

          {
            "text": "title: \"Car Stalls at Idle: What to Check First\"",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "  description: \"Car stalls at idle or dies at stop lights? Learn how to diagnose and fix the most common causes — dirty throttle body, vacuum leaks, IAC valve, and more — in your driveway.\"",
            "lineNumber": 48

          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "import FixFlow from '@/components/mdx/FixFlow.astro'",

            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "You're sitting at a red light and the engine just… quits. Or it stumbles and nearly dies when you shift into drive. Idle stalling is one of the most common driveability complaints, and while it feels alarming, the cause is usually something simple and fixable.",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "Your engine needs three things to idle smoothly: the right amount of air, the right amount of fuel, and a reliable spark. When idle stalling happens, one of those three is off. Let's figure out which one.",
            "lineNumber": 60
          }

          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "When you turn the key and hear clicking but your car won't start, you're dealing with one of the most common automotive problems. The good news? **This is usually a simple fix you can handle yourself.**",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "That clicking sound is your starter trying to engage but not getting enough power to turn the engine. In 90% of cases, it's either a dead battery, corroded connections, or a failing starter.",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },

          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },

          {
            "text": "1. **Dead or weak battery** (70% of cases)",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Corroded battery terminals** (15% of cases)",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Bad starter** (10% of cases)",

## Code Review Report: Driveway Mechanic Astro Site

### CRITICAL (would break the site)

1. Missing canonical URL fallback — `src/layouts/Layout.astro:43`
   - Issue: Canonical link only renders if `canonical` prop is provided. Should always render.
   - Impact: Missing canonical URLs can hurt SEO.
   - Fix: Always render canonical, using `canonical || Astro.url.href`.

2. Potential broken link in Article breadcrumbs — `src/layouts/Article.astro:40`
   - Issue: `getSection([primaryHub])` may return a section that doesn't match the article's route.
   - Impact: Breadcrumb links could point to wrong sections.
   - Fix: Ensure breadcrumb logic matches the routing logic used in `[...slug].astro` pages.

### HIGH (visible to users/SEO)

3. Missing alt text on conditional image — `src/components/mdx/AffiliateProduct.astro:29`
   - Issue: Image has `alt={name}` which is good, but if `name` is empty/missing, alt would be empty.
   - Impact: Accessibility issue if `name` prop is not provided.
   - Fix: Add fallback: `alt={name || "Product image"}`.

4. JSON-LD missing required fields — `src/layouts/Article.astro:57-74`
   - Issue: Article JSON-LD may be missing `mainEntityOfPage` URL.
   - Impact: Incomplete structured data.
   - Fix: Add `mainEntityOfPage: { "@type": "WebPage", "@id": pageUrl }`.

5. Canonical URL inconsistency — `src/layouts/Article.astro:91`
   - Issue: Uses `frontmatter.seo?.canonicalUrl` but doesn't construct full URL if relative.
   - Impact: Invalid canonical URLs if relative paths are provided.
   - Fix: Ensure canonical URLs are absolute: `canonical={frontmatter.seo?.canonicalUrl ? new URL(frontmatter.seo.canonicalUrl, siteUrl).href : undefined}`.

6. Missing meta description fallback — `src/layouts/Layout.astro:19`
   - Issue: Uses `description || defaultDescription`, but if `description` is empty string, it won't use default.
   - Impact: Empty meta descriptions on some pages.
   - Fix: `description?.trim() || defaultDescription`.

7. Hardcoded year in copyright — `src/layouts/Layout.astro:238`
   - Issue: Copyright shows `2026` hardcoded.
   - Impact: Will be outdated next year.
   - Fix: Use `new Date().getFullYear()`.

8. RSS feed link construction — `src/pages/rss.xml.ts:21`
   - Issue: Uses `/${section}/${slug}` but `context.site` may not include trailing slash.
   - Impact: RSS links may be malformed.
   - Fix: Ensure proper URL construction: `new URL(\`/${section}/${slug}\`, context.site).href`.

### MEDIUM (code quality)

9. Unused import check needed — `src/layouts/Article.astro:3-5`
   - Issue: `TimeCostSkill` and `VehicleFitment` are imported but only used conditionally. Verify they're always needed.
   - Status: They are used conditionally (lines 150-157), which is fine, but ensure they're tree-shaken if unused.

10. Type safety in hubs filtering — `src/pages/fix/index.astro:8`
    - Issue: Uses `data.hubs.some((h: string) => ...)` with explicit type annotation, but `hubs` is already typed from schema.
    - Impact: Redundant type annotation.
    - Fix: Remove explicit `: string` annotation.

11. Missing error handling for date parsing — `src/layouts/Article.astro:47-53`
    - Issue: `formatDate` function doesn't handle invalid dates.
    - Impact: Could throw runtime errors.
    - Fix: Add try-catch or validation.

12. Duplicate ID potential — `src/layouts/Layout.astro:109, 112, 119, 122`
    - Issue: Multiple elements with IDs (`theme-icon-light`, `theme-icon-dark`, `menu-icon-open`, `menu-icon-close`) are fine since they're in the same component scope, but ensure they're unique across the page.
    - Status: These are fine as they're in the same component.

13. Inline script blocking — `src/layouts/Layout.astro:156-182`
    - Issue: Large inline script for theme toggle runs synchronously.
    - Impact: Could block initial render.
    - Fix: Consider moving to external script or using `defer`.

14. Missing type annotation — `src/components/mdx/VideoEmbed.astro:10-42`
    - Issue: `getEmbedUrl` and `parseTimestamp` functions lack explicit return types.
    - Impact: Less type safety.
    - Fix: Add return type annotations: `: string` and `: number`.

### LOW (nice to have)

15. Magic string for default hub — `src/layouts/Article.astro:38`
    - Issue: `"articles"` is hardcoded as fallback.
    - Impact: Could be a constant.
    - Fix: Extract to constant: `const DEFAULT_HUB = "articles"`.

16. Inconsistent spacing in breadcrumbs — `src/layouts/Article.astro:98-104`
    - Issue: Breadcrumb separator uses `/` character instead of proper styling.
    - Impact: Minor visual inconsistency.
    - Fix: Use proper separator styling or icon.

17. Hardcoded color values — Multiple files
    - Issue: Some Tailwind classes use hardcoded colors (e.g., `text-red-600`) instead of theme tokens.
    - Impact: Less maintainable if color scheme changes.
    - Fix: Consider using CSS variables for brand colors.

18. Missing loading="lazy" on images — `src/components/mdx/AffiliateProduct.astro:29`
    - Issue: Image doesn't have `loading="lazy"` attribute.
    - Impact: Minor performance improvement opportunity.
    - Fix: Add `loading="lazy"`.

19. Footer link missing from mobile menu — `src/layouts/Layout.astro:130-137`
    - Issue: Mobile menu doesn't include "Seasonal" link (wait, it does on line 136).
    - Status: Actually present, no issue.

20. RSS feed missing language tag — `src/pages/rss.xml.ts:24`
    - Issue: Custom data includes `<language>en-us</language>` but should use proper RSS format.
    - Impact: Minor RSS validation issue.
    - Fix: Ensure proper RSS 2.0 language tag format.

### Summary

- Critical: 2 issues
- High: 6 issues
- Medium: 5 issues
- Low: 5 issues

Most critical: canonical URL handling and JSON-LD completeness. The site structure is solid; these are refinements for SEO, accessibility, and maintainability.

All internal links (`/fix`, `/maintain`, `/buy`, `/learn`, `/seasonal`, `/disclaimer`, `/affiliate-disclosure`, `/privacy-policy`) appear valid based on the file structure. External links (YouTube, NHTSA, Google policies) are properly formatted with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
